audience: freelancers and small businesses that do invoicing and bookkeeping in Billomat

useCases.title: Find overdue or open invoices and the clients behind them
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices filtered by client, status (DRAFT, OPEN, PAID, OVERDUE, CANCELED), dates or text. Each invoice has totals and the open amount, and you can also list payment reminders.

useCases.title: Total your invoiced revenue by month or client
useCases.text: The AI reads invoice totals grouped by client, status, day, week, month or year, with the same filters as the invoice list. You get revenue per month in one answer.

useCases.title: Check which offers are still open
useCases.text: The AI lists offers filtered by client, status (DRAFT, OPEN, WON, LOST, CANCELED, CLEARED), dates or text, and opens one for totals and validity.

useCases.title: Review supplier invoices you still have to pay
useCases.text: The AI lists incoming invoices from suppliers with status OPEN, PAID or OVERDUE and the open amount. It can open one and list suppliers.

useCases.title: Add a client, then prepare a draft invoice or offer
useCases.text: The AI creates a client, and a draft invoice or draft offer with line items. Drafts are not completed and not sent, so you review them in Billomat first.
